messages.author: Ann Example
messages.text: The tomatoes look dry again. Shall we water twice a day from Monday?

messages.author: Bo Sample
messages.text:
Twice is a lot for the peppers.
Let us keep the peppers on once a day.

messages.author: Cy Placeholder
messages.text:
Агрегат полива на второй грядке опять течёт.
Я поставлю ведро.

messages.author: Ann Example
messages.text: Thanks. Then: tomatoes twice a day, peppers once.

messages.author: Dee Sampleton
messages.text:
Late to this. The rain barrel is empty, so watering twice needs the tap.

The tap water is cold in the morning; wait until nine.

messages.author: Ann Example
messages.text: Good point. Morning round at nine, evening round at six.

messages.author: Cy Placeholder
messages.text: Ведро поставил. Нужен новый шланг на десять метров.

messages.author: Bo Sample
messages.text: I can buy the hose on Saturday.

messages.author: Ann Example
messages.text: Decision for the log: from Monday the tomatoes are watered at nine and at six; the peppers at nine only.

messages.author: Bo Sample
messages.text: Bought the hose: ten metres, green.

messages.author: Dee Sampleton
messages.text: The bucket under the second bed is full. Emptied it into the barrel.

messages.author: Ann Example
messages.text: Then the bucket can go back to the shed.

messages.author: Bo Sample
messages.text: Morning round done at nine sharp.

messages.author: Cy Placeholder
messages.text: Перцы полил один раз, как договорились.
